zh: 认全图事物 → 化格框 peep；WHOLE 可回洞，PART 仅展格

equation: ∀i: cell_i = frame(peep(box_i)); RETURN = hardpaste(WHOLE only, exclusive); PART ⊏ grid only

layers.格框: 展示/认物 · 每物一 cell peep
layers.回图: 仅 WHOLE · bbox 或 接+A 剪影后 hardpaste · outside=0
layers.PART: 细部格 · 不独立回洞

gates.G_G2: 格框 cell 有框有 id

vs_plain_C.C_grid: 全图万物格展 + WHOLE/PART 分流 + 可选合众回

I-ID-BAN.zh: 禁身份 donor 冒高宣称
I-ID-BAN.rule: if donor is peep (identity) ⇒ claim ≤ C0_IDENTITY; BAN C2_WHOLE_RETURN / C2_*_RETURN

I-PROCESS.zh: WHOLE/正回 必须真处理证据
I-PROCESS.rule: WHOLE return claim requires: densify_asset_id|elev_child AND tex_gain ≥ τ (default 1.15) AND seat_born AND outside==0
I-PROCESS.code_gate: PASS_RETURN = outside==0 and processed and seat_born and tex_gain>=tau
